guard: guided setup enumerates every registered connector and derives readiness and plugin hints from connector declarations rather than connector names
why: The old picker admitted only the literal names claude and opencode. A test covering only those names would certify the bug, so this fixture registers a connector name the CLI has never heard of and pins the candidate count to a literal four.
The mutations independently restore name-based membership and name-based plugin hints. Each must redden its own genericity assertion.

mutations.name: restore the claude and opencode membership gate
mutations.expectRed: every registered connector appears in setup candidates
mutations.cell: every registered connector appears in setup candidates

mutations.name: restore the claude name check for plugin hints
mutations.expectRed: a non-claude connector with pluginRoot gets the plugin hint
mutations.cell: a non-claude connector with pluginRoot gets the plugin hint
